achievements.name: My Cure Is Most Effective...
achievements.description: As SCP-049, cure ten people in a single game.

achievements.name: Pacified
achievements.description: Kill SCP-096 while it’s entering rage.

achievements.name: Melancholy of Decay
achievements.description: As SCP-106, capture a player within five seconds of emerging from the ground.

achievements.name: Don’t Blink
achievements.description: Successfully evade SCP-173.

achievements.name: Lights Out
achievements.description: Respawn as Nine-Tailed Fox.

achievements.name: It's Always Left, Brothers!
achievements.description: Escape as Class-D personnel.

achievements.name: Access Granted
achievements.description: As Class-D, kill a Scientist holding a keycard.

achievements.name: We of Delta Command...
achievements.description: Respawn as Chaos Insurgency.

achievements.name: Proceed With Caution
achievements.description: Successfully pass through a Tesla gate that SCP-079 is monitoring.

achievements.name: Friendship
achievements.description: As a Scientist, successfully upgrade your keycard alongside any amount of Class-D.

achievements.name: For Science!
achievements.description: Escape as a Scientist.

achievements.name: Is This Thing On?
achievements.description: Broadcast a 'helpful' message via the Intercom.

achievements.name: Fire In The Hole!
achievements.description: Kill an enemy using a grenade.

achievements.name: He’ll Be Back...
achievements.description: Successfully escape from the Pocket Dimension.

achievements.name: Be Polite. Be Efficient.
achievements.description: Kill five enemies in less than 30 seconds.

achievements.name: Executive Access
achievements.description: Obtain a max-level keycard.

achievements.name: Secure. Contain. Protect.
achievements.description: As MTF, kill the final SCP in a round.

achievements.name: T-Minus 90 seconds...
achievements.description: Survive a successful Alpha Warhead Detonation.

achievements.name: Change in Command
achievements.description: Disarm an MTF operative.

achievements.name: ... You Thinking What I'm Thinking?
achievements.description: Find any gun as a Class-D.

achievements.name: They Are Just Resources...
achievements.description: Detain or kill 50 Class-D as a Scientist.

achievements.name: That was... close.
achievements.description: Cancel the Alpha Warhead detonation within the last 15 seconds of the countdown.

achievements.name: If you want something done right...
achievements.description: Kill an SCP as a Scientist.

achievements.name: Walk It Off
achievements.description: Survive a fall with less than half of your health remaining.

achievements.name: Anomalously Efficient
achievements.description: As an SCP, get a kill within the first minute of the game.

achievements.name: Microwave Meal
achievements.description: Kill an SCP with the Micro H.I.D.

achievements.name: Happy Halloween!
achievements.description: Play the Halloween version of the game.

achievements.name: Merry Christmas!
achievements.description: Play the Christmas version of the game.

achievements.name: Escape Artist
achievements.description: Be the first to escape the Facility.

achievements.name: High on the Wings of Caffeine
achievements.description: Escape while under the effects of SCP-207.

achievements.name: Crisis Averted
achievements.description: Use SCP-500 when you're about to die.

achievements.name: Ha! I didn't even feel that!
achievements.description: Use adrenaline to survive a hit that would otherwise kill you.

achievements.name: I'll Pass, Thanks
achievements.description: As an SCP, kill someone who's charging or firing the Micro H.I.D.

achievements.name: Overcurrent
achievements.description: Try to recharge the Micro H.I.D.

achievements.name: Property of the Chaos Insurgency
achievements.description: Liberate two or more SCP objects from the Facility, while escaping as a Class-D.

achievements.name: Overtime
achievements.description: Survive an entire round without dying as a Facility Guard.

achievements.name: Rule Breaker
achievements.description: Consume 3 candies from SCP-330 in a single life.

achievements.name: Complete the Mission
achievements.description: Complete a round as the last surviving member of the winning team.

achievements.name: Army of One
achievements.description: In a single life, get 4 kills using 4 different weapons.

achievements.name: LMGG
achievements.description: Using an LMG, get 3 kills without letting go of the trigger.

achievements.name: On Speaking Terms
achievements.description: As a Chaos Insurgent, use a radio to communicate with MTF.

achievements.name: Hats Off to You!
achievements.description: Get a kill immediately after canceling the effects of SCP-268.

achievements.name: Amnestic Ambush
achievements.description: As SCP-939, kill a player under the effects of your Amnestic Cloud using Lunge.

achievements.name: Afterlife Communicator
achievements.description: Contact the dead using SCP-1576.

achievements.name: Signal Lost
achievements.description: Cut SCP-079’s connection using SCP-2176.

achievements.name: Hawkeye
achievements.description: Reveal an enemy player under the effects of SCP-268 using SCP-1344.

achievements.name: Think Fast!
achievements.description: Kill a player using SCP-018.

achievements.name: Trilateral Termination
achievements.description: In a single life, kill three enemy players with the 3-X Particle Disruptor.

achievements.name: Mutually-Assured Destruction
achievements.description: Kill someone with a grenade after your death.

achievements.name: Undead Space Program
achievements.description: Kill an instance of 049-2 using a charged hit with the Jailbird.

achievements.name: Arizona Ranger
achievements.description: Get a headshot kill with a Revolver from over 25 meters away.

achievements.name: Tooth and Nail
achievements.description: Reach a tier three bond with SCP-127.
